name: pytermtk-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is pyTermTk (TermTk), a Python toolkit for building text-based user interfaces in the
terminal: widgets, layouts, signals and slots, colored terminal strings, a text document and cursor model, drag and
drop, a clipboard wrapper, and table and tree models with their views.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
The code in scope is pyTermTk's core utilities, layouts, text and GUI helpers, abstract models and model/view widgets: the modules directly inside libs/pyTermTk/TermTk/TTkCore/ (every module there except: ttk.py, timer_pyodide.py; its drivers/ and TTkTerm/ subpackages are out of scope) and the packages libs/pyTermTk/TermTk/TTkLayouts/, libs/pyTermTk/TermTk/TTkGui/, libs/pyTermTk/TermTk/TTkAbstract/ and libs/pyTermTk/TermTk/TTkWidgets/TTkModelView/. The documentation in scope is: tutorial/002-layout.rst, tutorial/003-signalslots.rst, tutorial/004-logging.rst, docs/source/info/resources/clipboard.rst and docs/source/info/resources/dragdrop.rst, together with the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
evidence
